title: Watershed Hydrology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means to spell out all kinds of problems together and use all kinds of resources to give the best solutions."
Integrated approach usually means to spell out all kinds of problems together and use all kinds of resources to give the best solutions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key to the success of many watershed programs in the world."
People's participation is the key to the success of many watershed programs in the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the divide separating one drainage area from another."
Watershed boundary is the divide separating one drainage area from another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as ground water."
Water in the saturated zone is referred to as ground water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main cause of the brown appearance of many rivers and streams."
The suspended load is the main cause of the brown appearance of many rivers and streams.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the path of water and sediment flowing within the stream banks."
The stream channel is the path of water and sediment flowing within the stream banks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the flat area of land surrounding a body of water that is subject to periodic flooding."
The floodplain is the flat area of land surrounding a body of water that is subject to periodic flooding.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to any stream, river, pond, lake, estuary or ocean."
A water body refers to any stream, river, pond, lake, estuary or ocean.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the largest physical processes on Earth, which is driven by energy from the sun and by the force of gravity, it supplies all of the water needed to support life."
The water cycle is one of the largest physical processes on Earth, which is driven by energy from the sun and by the force of gravity, it supplies all of the water needed to support life.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any chemical, physical or biological change in the quality of water that has a harmful effect on any living thing that drinks or uses or lives in it."
Water pollution is any chemical, physical or biological change in the quality of water that has a harmful effect on any living thing that drinks or uses or lives in it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a graph showing stream flow at the concentration point versus time."
A hydrograph is a graph showing stream flow at the concentration point versus time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the biological, physical and chemical transformations of elements that are found in soil, water and air."
Biogeochemical cycling refers to the biological, physical and chemical transformations of elements that are found in soil, water and air.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which water moves down through the profile and into the underlying soil profile and weathered rock."
Percolation is the process by which water moves down through the profile and into the underlying soil profile and weathered rock.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of scientific and engineering discipline that deals with the occurrence, distribution, movement, and properties of the water of the earth."
Hydrology is a branch of scientific and engineering discipline that deals with the occurrence, distribution, movement, and properties of the water of the earth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a hydraulic action and is derived from the energy of running water."
Erosion is a hydraulic action and is derived from the energy of running water.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an area that supplies water by surface or subsurface flow to a given drainage system or body of water, be it a stream, river, wetland, lake, or ocean."
A watershed is an area that supplies water by surface or subsurface flow to a given drainage system or body of water, be it a stream, river, wetland, lake, or ocean.
